one_line: Madurai Nayaka leader who expanded Vijayanagara authority across the Tamil south in the mid-16th century.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, athletic and broad-shouldered with a disciplined warrior’s build.
appearance.face: Oval face with a strong jaw, warm medium-brown Tamil complexion, sharp dark eyes, straight nose, neatly trimmed moustache and short beard line along the jaw; default expression calm, alert and decisive.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair parted at the center, drawn back into a compact, low bun at the nape; front kept smooth without stray strands; adorned with a simple gold circlet-style band resting above the forehead, narrow and unornamented.
appearance.costume: He wears a mid-16th-century South Indian noble-warrior outfit: a deep maroon silk angarkha-style upper garment crossing right-over-left and tied at the side, with long fitted sleeves and a subtle gold border at the edges; beneath it, an off-white cotton tunic collar peeks at the neckline; his lower garment is a tightly wrapped cream-coloured cotton veshti/dhoti, pleated in front and reaching the ankles, with a thin maroon and gold border; around his torso he has a broad, dark green silk waist sash tied firmly, the knot slightly off-center, and over one shoulder a muted gold pattu-uttariya (silk shawl) draped diagonally across his chest and back; his feet are in simple brown leather sandals; jewellery is restrained—a pair of small gold stud earrings, one plain gold kada (bangle) on each wrist, and a medium-width gold chain at the neck with a single flat, round pendant resting just below the collarbone.
appearance.signature: A long, slightly curved South Indian steel sword (early 16th-century style) with a plain iron hilt and a modestly decorated gold pommel, carried in a brown leather scabbard with subtle gold fittings and usually held at his left hip or drawn in his right hand.

ref_desc: Viswanatha Nayaka is a calm, sharp-eyed Tamil warrior in a deep maroon angarkha over a cream dhoti, dark green waist sash, muted gold shoulder shawl, gold circlet and simple jewellery, carrying a curved South Indian steel sword in a brown leather scabbard, with a compact back bun and warm medium-brown complexion.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Viswanatha Nayaka: an early-40s Tamil warrior-leader with an oval, strong-jawed face, warm medium-brown skin, sharp dark eyes, neat moustache and jawline beard, and thick black hair pulled into a compact low bun at the back, topped with a narrow gold circlet band above the forehead. Show him wearing a deep maroon silk angarkha-style upper garment crossing right-over-left with long fitted sleeves and subtle gold borders, an off-white tunic collar just visible at the neck, and a cream cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped tightly to the ankles with a thin maroon-and-gold border. Around his waist is a broad dark green silk sash tied firmly, and a muted gold pattu-uttariya shawl drapes diagonally from one shoulder across his chest and back. Place simple brown leather sandals on his feet and add restrained jewellery: small gold stud earrings, one plain gold bangle on each wrist, and a medium-width gold chain with a single round pendant at his upper chest. At his left hip show a brown leather scabbard with subtle gold fittings holding a long, slightly curved South Indian steel sword with a plain iron hilt and gold pommel; in one pose he lightly rests his right hand on the hilt or holds the drawn sword. Emphasize consistent colours—deep maroon, cream, dark green, muted gold and brown leather—clearly visible from head to toe, with multiple views or stances that keep his fixed hairstyle, outfit and sword design identical across the sheet.
